packageRules.description: Auto-merge digest updates (same tag, new content)
Protect the mios.toml SSOT  an exact-pin bump there reprojects into every generated surface, so it gets a human

customManagers.description: Pin digest of BASE_IMAGE ARG in Containerfile  the dockerfile manager only pins bare FROM lines, not ARG defaults

Keep the [image.sidecars] refs that CANNOT float current. Everything upstream publishes a moving tag for floats instead (ADR-0012) and is deliberately unmanaged here; k3s publishes no usable channel tag, and its version-shaped tag is also what automation/06-enable-external-repos.sh parses the Kubernetes repo minor from, so it must stay version-shaped and gets bumped by the bot rather than by hand. pinDigests is off on purpose  a hand-written @sha256 in the SSOT is exactly what ADR-0003 and check_no_hardcode_version forbid.
